claim: Backport the reference BCM4389 protocol fixes into an isolated external module build compatible with the verified Oriole kernel; then test firmware boot and interface creation without association.
oracle: Exact kernel ABI, expected board firmware hashes, no startup firmware crash or MMIO/window overrun, one wireless interface and firmware-version evidence, followed by verified clean unbind and power-off.

user_journey.scenario: User opens Wi-Fi settings and can eventually select a network; this stage must first create the actual wireless interface. A failed probe or interrupted trial returns to the existing GPU/touch desktop through guarded teardown or watchdog recovery.
user_journey.expected: Radio discovery proceeds to a real interface; errors remain recorded, no networking claim based on module registration alone.

invariants: Only drivers/net/wireless/broadcom/brcm80211 from a pinned Omarchy kernel snapshot; no SoC addresses, PCI host, PMIC or shared-kernel source changes.
Review BCM4389 SYSMEM bank decode, BAR-window bounds/locking, power request and coherent bits, H2D epoch and nonzero packet IDs, reset-work lifetime, current firmware protocol changes.
Use Oriole stock NVRAM/CLM, never Pixel7 board calibration. Firmware binary hash matches reference but board files differ.
No SysMMU/S2MPU changes; short development-only trial, no default-on promotion without a separate DMA confinement decision.
Hold endpoint with driver_override while base/vendor dependencies load; restore loader path and unload endpoint before host/PHY.
gitnexus: External kernel not indexed; use pinned source diff and direct call/control-flow review.
ast: Compile actual isolated module; test extracted deterministic bank/window/epoch contracts when changed source requires it.

unit.red: Base source must exhibit missing BCM4389 bank/window fixes; reject mismatched firmware and bad/overlapping window ranges in focused contracts.
unit.green: Verified upstream logic plus exact-kernel build; lifecycle and mapping tests pass.
cases: teardown refuses host removal after endpoint-unbind failure

evidence: W1 final v4a enumerated14e4:4441 overGen2x1, command0, clean unload and rail-off.
Reference WIFI-BATTERY-PLAN9.1-9.3 documents known initial driver faults; current source still uses pre-window TCM addressing and initial BCM4389 IDs.
Actual firmware20.101.90 and wlan0 observed; cleaned then confirmed through independent serial invocation.
limitations: BCM4389 fixes from another board still require real Oriole firmware/interface acceptance.
Existing enumeration-only overlay has no restricted DMA pool; no production default-on or association/traffic acceptance in this stage.
SIM, voice, camera and persistent boot remain incomplete.
exit_gate: Source review, scoped contracts and warning-free ABI-matched build before powered W2 trial; actual interface and clean rollback before association; full mobile network requires separate traffic/reconnect tests.
status: W2 firmware and wlan0 PASS; clean rollback/fresh confirmation PASS. W3 pending.
